title: atlanthemum sanguineum subvar. erectipes
intro: Atlanthemum sanguineum subvar. erectipes, commonly known as Red Sea Lavender, is a subspecies of the Atalanthemum sanguineum plant, characterized by its unique and compact growth habit. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Red Sea Lavender include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and promote better sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
